RELATIONAL SPATIAL MAPPING (GPUI / OS-AGNOSTIC)

Consolidates tabular silos into four core operational planes:
1. Topography (Spatial & Relational Map)
2. Brain & Agents (Ouros-X Adapter Plane)
3. Execution & Telemetry (Processes & Resources)
4. Substrate (Storage & Volumes)

Features live force-directed spatial simulation, Descriptive Topology Mini-Map sidebar, Contextual Diagnostics Drawer with one-click remediations, and Right Rail Persistent Contextual Terminal.
